title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache/parallelism
author: Samira Patel
description: Unify CI workflows across lint, test, and release pipelines with a focus on reducing duplicate matrix builds, improving cache locality, and exposing parallelism knobs for faster pipeline turnaround. This PR consolidates separate workflow files into a single orchestrator that dynamically composes jobs for SDKs, the monorepo packages, and release automation. Motivation: lengthy CI times (observed 25-40% variance across runs), confusing duplicated configs across repositories, and frequent stale action versions. Changes include: consolidated workflow templates, improved build cache keys (repo-sha + arch + deps-hash), conditional job execution to skip unaffected packages, split expensive integration tests into labeled parallel shards, and pinned critical actions with automated bumping via dependabot workflow. Checklist: - Run full lint/test matrix locally and in CI - Validate cache hit rates on canary runs - Coordinate release automation owners for approval - Add migration note in CONTRIBUTING.md Related Linear items: ENG-3219 ENG-3450 ENG-3621
